facts.chief_complaint: Persistent cough and abnormal chest CT

findings.text: Exertional dyspnea, stops on the second flight of stairs
findings.evidence: exertional dyspnea that now stops her on the second flight of stairs

findings.text: Painful red lumps on both shins for 3 weeks
findings.evidence: she noticed painful red lumps on both shins

findings.text: Pain in both ankles, walking difficult in the morning
findings.evidence: pain in both ankles that makes walking difficult in the morning

findings.text: Tender erythematous nodules on the front of both shins
findings.evidence: Tender erythematous nodules on the anterior aspect of both shins

findings.text: Periarticular swelling and tenderness of both ankles
findings.evidence: Periarticular swelling and tenderness of both ankles

findings.text: CT chest: bilateral hilar and mediastinal lymphadenopathy
findings.evidence: CT chest: bilateral hilar and mediastinal lymphadenopathy

findings.text: CT chest: perilymphatic nodules along bronchovascular bundles in both upper lobes
findings.evidence: perilymphatic nodules along the bronchovascular bundles in both upper lobes

findings.text: EBUS-TBNA of subcarinal and right hilar nodes: non-caseating epithelioid granulomas
findings.evidence: EBUS-TBNA of the subcarinal and right hilar nodes showed non-caseating epithelioid granulomas

final_diagnosis.name: Sarcoidosis
final_diagnosis.evidence: sarcoidosis, Scadding stage II, presenting as Löfgren syndrome

differential.name: Tuberculosis
differential.evidence: Tuberculosis is unlikely with a negative IGRA

differential.name: Lymphoma
differential.evidence: Lymphoma was considered because of the nodal enlargement

diagnosis_aliases: Sarcoidosis of lung with sarcoidosis of lymph nodes
